simple.meaning: properly, to mark (so as to be recognized), i.e. to remember ; by implication, to mention ; to be male
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to זָכַר (H2142) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 235 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: זָכַר (zâkar) means properly, to mark (so as to be recognized), i.e. to remember ; by implication, to mention ; to be male First listed occurrence: 1Chr 16 4.

definitions.short: properly, to mark (so as to be recognized), i.e. to remember ; by implication, to mention ; to be male
definitions.usage: × burn (incense), × earnestly, be male, (make) mention (of), be mindful, recount, record(-er), remember, make to be remembered, bring (call, come, keep, put) to (in) remembrance, × still, think on, × well.

Ezek 23:19 , etc.; suffix בְּזָכְרֵנִי Psa 137:1 ; Participle active plural construct וּלְֹזכְרֵי 103:18 ; זָכוּר 103:14 see below — I. human subj . 1 remember, recall, call to mind , usually as affecting present feeling, thought, or action: a. remember past experiences (accusative) Gen 42:9 (E), 2Kin 9:25 (accusative of person agent); followed by clause with מִי Job 4:7 ; things formerly known (accusative) Jer 17:2 ; followed by clause with כִּי Judg 9:2 ; with implied regret, longing Num 11:5 (JE), Psa 42:5 ; 137:1 ; Lam 1:7 compare Psa 77:7 , negative 137:6 (|| שׁכח 137:5 ); so (followed by בְּ ) Jer 3:16 (|| לב על עלה and פקד ). b. recall past distress, etc.; object not expressed, Lam 3:20 ( זכר זכור ), Job 11:16 ( שׁכח in || clause); negative, followed by accusative Isa 54:4 (|| שׁכח ), Prov 31:7 (|| id. ). c. remember sins, (1) to repent of them Deut 9:7 (+ אלתֿשׁכח , followed by clause with אתאֿשׁר ), elsewhere only Ezek., usually with accusative Ezek 16:61 (+ וְנִכְלַמְתְּ ), 16:63 (object not expressed), 20:43 ; 36:21 ; (2) to renew and repeat them 23:19 , negative 23:27 . d. especially remember the dealings of ׳י , expressed in great variety of terms in accusative, Deut 7:18 ; 8:2 ; 24:9 ; 32:7 (|| בין ), Isa 46:9 ; 63:11 ; Psa 77:12 Qr (Kt Hiph`il q. v.) 77:12 ; 105:5 ; 143:5 (|| אֲשׂוֺחֵחַ הגיתי, ) 1Chr 16:12 ; negatively, Isa 43:18 ; (|| תִּתְבֹּנָ֑נוּ אַל ), Ezek 16:22 , 43 ; Psa 78:42 ; 106:7 ; Neh 9:17 (|| לִשְׁמֹעַ וַיְמָאֲנוּ ); object clause with בִּי especially D, Deut 5:15 ; 15:15 ; 16:12 ; 24:18 , 22 ; Psa 78:35 . 2 remember persons (human subject), a. to their advantage : — followed by accusative Gen 40:14 (E), 40:23 (E; negative, || שׁכח ), 1Sam 25:31 . b. to make use of them (accusative) Nahum 2:6 . c. their acts (accusative) to their advantage 2Chr 24:22 , to their disadvantage 2Sam 19:20 (negative); to make vengeance Deut 25:17 . d. remember human obligations, accusative of thing: אַחִים בְּרִית Amos 1:9 ; compare perhaps Est 2:1 (accusative of person and also of deed); negative Eccl 9:15 (accusative of person), Psa 109:16 (followed by עשׂות חסד ). 3 remember ׳י : a. call him to mind 2Sam 14:11 (i.e. recall a specific command of his). b. recall , and (especially) keep ׳י in mind Deut 8:18 ; Jer 51:50 ; Isa 64:4 (|| צדק עשׂה ), Ezek 6:9 ; Zech 10:9 ; Joel 2:8 ; Psa 42:7 ; 63:7 (|| אהגה ), 77:4 ; Neh 4:8 ; negatively Judg 8:34 ; Isa 17:10 (opposed to שׁכח ), 57:11 (|| עַללִֿבֵּךְ שַׂמְתְּ לֹא ); compare also ׳ז אֶתאבּוֺרְאֶ֑ךָ Eccl 12:1 , and (no object expressed) Psa 22:28 (+ י אל ׳וישׁובו ); remember ׳י s name 119:55 . 4 remember: a. words of Moses Josh 1:13 (D) Malachi 3:22; ׳י s instructions through prophet Isa 44:21 ; Isaiah 46:48 (|| לב על השׁיבו ), also Micah 6:5 (followed by clause with מה ). b. commandments of ׳י (so as to do them) Num 15:39 (P, or H), 15:40 (P; + ועשׂיתם ), Psa 103:18 (+ לעשׂותם ), 119:52 ( משׁפטים ); his covenant 1Chr 16:15 . 5 think of or on, call to mind something present or future: — followed by accusative, issue of conduct Isa 47:7 ; Lam 1:9 (end of Jerusalem); fight with crocodile Job 40:32; object a General truth, prosperity of wicked Job 21:6 (object not expressed); (fleeting) days of life Eccl 5:19 ; (coming) days of darkness, 11:8 ; a duty Job 36:24 (followed by clause with כִּי ). 6 remember a day, to observe, commemorate it: — day of Exodus Exod 13:3 (J) Deut 16:3 ; sabbath Exod 20:8 (E; || שׂמר Deut 5:12 ). 7 remember , with implied mention of , object ׳י Jer 20:9 (|| בִּשְׁמוֺ דִּבֶּר ); י ׳מַשָּׂא 23:36 . II. Subject ׳(אלהים)י . 1 remember persons: a. individuals, with kindness, granting requests, protecting, delivering etc., with accusative of person, Gen 30:22 (E), 1Sam 1:11 (opposed to שׁכח ), 1:19 , Judg 16:28 (followed by וְחַזְּקֵנִי ); Jer 15:15 (|| מָּקְדֵנִי ), Psa 106:4 (|| id. ), Job 14:13 (+ חק לי תשׁית ), also Gen 8:1 (P), 19:29 (P); negative Psa 88:6 (|| נִגְזָר֑וּ מידך ); followed by לְ person 25:7 (yet compare Che); followed by accusative of thing + לְ person (dativus commodi [dative of benefit]) Neh 5:19 ; 13:14 , 22 , 31 . b. individuals, to punish, followed by לְ person Neh 6:14 ; 13:29 . c. his servants, people, the afflicted, (graciously) followed by לְ Exod 32:13 (JE), Deut 9:27 ; Psa 136:23 ; followed by accusative 9:13 (opposed to שׁכח ), 74:2 ; 115:12 (followed by יְבָרֵךְ ); compare Jer 31:20 ( זכר זכור ). d. his land Lev 26:42 (H), and negative Lam 2:1 (his footstool). e. mankind Psa 8:5 (|| פקד ). 2. a. remember the distress of his servants, Lam 3:19 (followed by clause with מה ), 5:1 (|| וּרְאֵה הַבִּיטָ֯ ). b. their devotion, accusative, Psa 20:4 ; Jer 2:2 (+ לְ person), Psa 132:1 (+ id. ); followed by clause with אשׁר את 2Kin 20:3 = Isa 38:3 . c. their intercession Jer 18:20 (followed by infinitive with suffix) 3. a. remember his own covenant (with them), accusative, Gen 9:15-16 , Exod 2:24 ; 6:25 (all P), Lev 26:42 (twice in verse) (H, as also) 26:45 (+ לְ person); Jer 14:21 (+ אַלתָּֿפֵר ), Ezek 16:60 ; Psa 105:8 , compare 105:42 (object קָדְשׁוֺ דְּבַר ), and 119:49 ; Neh 1:8 ; Psa 106:45 (+ לְ person), 111:5 . b. his mercy, etc., accusative, Psa 25:6 ; 98:3 ; 2Chr 6:42 ; also Hab 3:2 . c. extenuating circumstances, followed by clause with כִּי , Job 7:7 ; 10:9 ; Psa 78:39 ; 103:14 ( זָכוּר be-thinketh him , Che, compare De Kö § 20, 14 Ba NB 175 ); also 89:48 (followed by אֲנִי + epexegetical clause with מה ). 4 remember sins, idolatries etc., followed by accusative, Hosea 7:2 ; 8:13 (|| פקד ), 9:9 (|| id. ), Jer 14:10 (|| id. ); negative 44:21 (|| לבו על עלה ), Isa 43:25 ; 64:8 ; Psa 25:7 ; 79:8 (+ לְ person); followed by לְ Jer 31:34 ; also (object reproach) Psa 74:18 ; 74:22 ; 89:5 ; and (object day of Jerusalem) 137:7 (+ אֱדוֺם לִבְנֵי , i.e. against them). Niph`al Perfect 2masculine plural consecutive וְנִזְכַּרְתֶּם Num 10:9 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular יִזָּכֵר Jer 11:19 +; 3 feminine singular תִּזָּכֵר Ezek 25:10 , ( תִּזָּכָר Exod 34:19 read הַזָּכָר see זָכָר ); 2 feminine singular תִּזָּכֵ֑רִי Isa 23:16 ; Ezekiel 21:37; 3 masculine plural יִזָָּֽכְרוּ Hosea 2:19 +; 3 feminine plural תִּזָּכַרְנָה Isa 65:17 +; תִּזָּכַרְןָ Ezek 3:20 ; Infinitive construct suffix הִזָּכֶרְכֶם 21:29 (omitted by ᵑ6 Co); Participle plural נִזְכָּרִים Est 9:28 . — 1 be brought to remembrance, remembered, thought of , usually with negative: — a. in General, subject Baalim Hosea 2:19 (+ בִּשְׁמָם ), compare Zech 13:2 (|| אכרית ); former heaven and earth Isa 65:17 (|| לב על עלה ); (wicked) dead Job 24:20 (|| ישׁכחהו v a ); coral (not to be thought of [others, be mentioned ] in comparison with wisdom) 28:18 ; of attention paid to Tyre under figure of harlot Isa 23:16 (opposed to נשׁכחה ). b. brought to ׳י 's remembrance , subject the people, (1) with gracious result Num 10:9 (P; י ׳לפני , || וְנוֺשַׁעְתֶּם ); (2) for judgment Ezek 21:29 (omitted by ᵑ6 Co). c. be remembered by ׳י , negative of deeds, as affecting ׳י s judgment, (1) righteous Ezek 3:20 ; 18:24 ; 33:13 (followed by לְ of advantage, according to Co); (2) wicked 18:22 (followed by לְ , omitted by A B ᵑ9 etc., Co) 33:16 (followed by לְ ). d. be remembered ׳אֶליֿ Psa 109:14 (|| אַלתִּֿמָּ֑ח ). 2 negative be not remembered = no longer exist, of name of Israel, as nation Jer 11:19 (|| נכרת ), Psa 83:5 (|| מִגּוֺי נַכְחִידֵם ); of Ammonites Ezekiel 21:37; Ezek 25:10 . 3 be remembered , of particular days, in order to be observed, commemorated, Est 9:28 (followed by וְנַעֲשִׂים observe, celebrate ).
